introduction.summary: This specification records the project purpose, stakeholder constraints and unresolved decisions stated in the source evidence below.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-001
items.detail: Design a secure backup and recovery management system for a university that protects critical data from academic departments, administrative systems, research platforms, and shared services.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-002
items.detail: The system should allow authorized administrators to define backup policies, initiate and monitor backup jobs, restore approved data, and review backup status across multiple campus locations.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-003
items.detail: It should detect failed or incomplete backup operations, generate security and operational alerts, maintain audit logs of backup and restore activities, and restrict backup administration based on user roles.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-004
items.detail: The platform should integrate with existing university storage and identity services and remain secure, reliable, scalable, and manageable.
